page.overview:
Who is The Lupine Hunters?

The Lupine Hunters are a duo consisting of Shannon McLaughlin and Curtis Soracco, who hunt werewolves and target isolated vampires for their blood — part of Vampire: The Masquerade.

They ran into The Crypt-Ticks in this story. Shannon McLaughlin became a hunter after a werewolf pack murdered his family, leading to false murder charges and an extensive psychiatric evaluation. He subsequently dedicated his life to destroying werewolves.
